statements.status_notes: The SDK has been updated with patched versions of the vulnerable packages, however the dotnet format tool is still reporting dependencies on vulnerable versions. Waiting on upstream response. (https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/issues/12643)
Affected version of the DLL is not present in the image. This is a false positive due to a deps.json file that still points to an old version fo the DLL.
